mutable struct BaseLlmConfig
    model::Union{Nothing,String}
    api_key::Union{Nothing,String}
    xai_base_url::Union{Nothing,String}
    temperature::Float64
    max_tokens::Int
    top_p::Float64
end

function BaseLlmConfig(; model=nothing, api_key=nothing, xai_base_url=nothing, temperature=1.0, max_tokens=4096, top_p=1.0)
    return BaseLlmConfig(model, api_key, xai_base_url, Float64(temperature), Int(max_tokens), Float64(top_p))
end

struct LLMBase
    config::BaseLlmConfig
end

struct OpenAIClient
    api_key::String
    base_url::String
end

function chat_completions_create(client::OpenAIClient, params::Dict{String,Any})
    url = string(client.base_url, "/chat/completions")
    headers = [
        "Authorization" => string("Bearer ", client.api_key),
        "Content-Type" => "application/json"
    ]
    body = JSON3.write(params)
    resp = HTTP.post(url, headers, body)
    if resp.status < 200 || resp.status >= 300
        error(String(resp.body))
    end
    return JSON3.read(String(resp.body))
end

struct XAILLM
    config::BaseLlmConfig
    client::OpenAIClient
end

function XAILLM(config::Union{Nothing,BaseLlmConfig}=nothing)
    cfg = config === nothing ? BaseLlmConfig() : config
    if cfg.model === nothing
        cfg.model = "grok-2-latest"
    end
    api_key = cfg.api_key !== nothing ? cfg.api_key::String : get(ENV, "XAI_API_KEY", "")
    base_url = cfg.xai_base_url !== nothing ? cfg.xai_base_url::String : get(ENV, "XAI_API_BASE", "")
    client = OpenAIClient(String(api_key), String(base_url))
    return XAILLM(cfg, client)
end

function generate_response(self::XAILLM, messages::Vector{Dict{String,Any}}, response_format=nothing, tools::Union{Nothing,Vector{Dict{String,Any}}}=nothing, tool_choice::String="auto")
    params = Dict{String,Any}()
    params["model"] = self.config.model
    params["messages"] = messages
    params["temperature"] = self.config.temperature
    params["max_tokens"] = self.config.max_tokens
    params["top_p"] = self.config.top_p
    if tools !== nothing
        params["tools"] = tools
        params["tool_choice"] = tool_choice
    end
    if response_format !== nothing
        params["response_format"] = response_format
    end
    response = chat_completions_create(self.client, params)
    return String(response[:choices][:message][:content])
end
